takeaways: An AI agent can assess a legacy Java app end to end, building a dependency graph with CVE, upgrade-readiness, cloud-readiness and cost findings before touching code.
The upgrade to Java 21 runs as an apply-build-test-patch loop with OpenRewrite recipes, BOM alignment, regenerated SBOMs and scanners, producing small reviewable commits.
Migration to Azure App Service with Key Vault, managed identity and GitHub Actions approvals cut cost and CVEs together while every change stays traceable in Git.
hook: Hand-upgrading legacy Java apps is slow, error-prone and leaves CVEs and idle cloud spend in place. This episode is for developers, platform engineers and IT leaders facing Java modernization. It walks through a case where an AI agent assesses, upgrades to Java 21 and migrates to Azure with a full audit trail.
